shapes.name: Identity
shapes.doc: CanonicalCharacter - the character entity schema. Seeded from RoleCall + SillyTavern + Risu, widened by the format deep-dive (see design/FORMATS-LANDSCAPE.md). Only fields a real now-tier format actually produces are first-classed here; everything else rides in original. This folder IS the character entity. Drop a sibling folder in src/entities/ to add a new content type (lorebook, preset, persona, regex) the same way.

fields.name: nickname
fields.meaning: {{char}} override that does NOT change the canonical name (Risu/Backyard aiName, CCv3 nickname)

fields.name: tagline
fields.meaning: short one-liner / creator comment

fields.name: description
fields.meaning: the main character description / persona block (CCv2/v3 `description`)

fields.name: fullName
fields.meaning: full/formal name distinct from the display name (RC details.full_name)

fields.name: title
fields.meaning: honorific / role title (RC details.title)

fields.name: age
fields.meaning: free TEXT in every producer ("23", "ageless", "300+ years"), never an int (RC details.age)

fields.name: pronouns
fields.meaning: RC details.pronouns

fields.name: culture
fields.meaning: Agnai culture: drives default language/voice selection

shapes.name: Voice
shapes.doc: Per-character voice/TTS selection - the authored SELECTION/config, never the model bytes (those are assets/original). Producers: Agnai `voice`+`voiceDisabled` (rich), Risu `vits` (narrow: only the vits config actually serializes to .charx; Risu's other TTS fields are app-local and never hit the wire).

fields.name: provider
fields.meaning: open union: "elevenlabs" | "webspeechsynthesis" | "novel" | "agnaistic" | "vits" | ...

fields.name: disabled
fields.meaning: creator turned voice off without discarding the config (Agnai voiceDisabled)

fields.name: extras
fields.meaning: provider-specific extras (stability, similarityBoost, model seed, vits config...) - authored, open

shapes.name: ImagePrompt
shapes.doc: Authored image-generation prompt hints: the text a creator writes to steer image gen for this character. Two real producers (Agnai imageSettings affixes; Risu sdData rows + newGenData), so the shape covers both: shared affix fields plus open labeled rows. Sampler/provider knobs are NOT here (platform config, original).

fields.name: prompt
fields.meaning: full base prompt (Risu newGenData.prompt)

fields.name: template
fields.meaning: prompt template (Agnai imageSettings.template)

fields.name: instructions
fields.meaning: freeform instruction text (Risu newGenData.instructions)

fields.name: emotionInstructions
fields.meaning: emotion-pack generation instructions (Risu newGenData.emotionInstructions)

fields.name: rows
fields.meaning: labeled prompt rows (Risu sdData: [["always","solo, 1girl"], ...])

fields.name: appearance
fields.meaning: Agnai-only free-text physical description (image-gen); other formats fold it into description

fields.name: voice
fields.meaning: per-character voice/TTS selection (Agnai voice, Risu vits)

fields.name: imagePrompt
fields.meaning: authored image-gen prompt hints (Agnai imageSettings affixes, Risu sdData/newGenData)

fields.name: structured
fields.meaning: structured persona encoding (Agnai persona.kind + attributes); preserves W++/attribute maps. Discriminated so illegal states are unrepresentable: plain "text" carries no attributes; every attribute-map kind requires its attributes.

fields.name: origin
fields.meaning: which source mechanism produced this, so it re-emits to its original home on export

fields.name: enabled
fields.meaning: creator toggle; undefined = enabled

fields.name: postHistoryInstructions
fields.meaning: the "jailbreak" / post-history slot in SillyTavern

fields.name: prefill
fields.meaning: assistant-response prefill, prepended to the model reply (Agnai; common with Claude)

fields.name: additionalText
fields.meaning: authored plain-append prompt text (Risu additionalText) - a simple append, not a depth injection

shapes.name: Greeting
shapes.doc: A greeting with an optional creator-given title (RoleCall alternate_greeting_titles, Backyard scenarios). `id` is optional stable editing/provenance identity (e.g. BYAF scenario path). Not portable content: other format writers must ignore it and emit only text/title.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: stable editing identity (format-local provenance); not user-facing content

fields.name: groupOnlyGreetings
fields.meaning: CCv3 group-chat-only greetings, distinct from alternateGreetings

fields.name: exampleMessages
fields.meaning: mes_example

fields.name: sourceUrl
fields.meaning: canonical/origin URL for the card (RoleCall source_url)

fields.name: creatorNotes
fields.meaning: single-language creator notes about the card (CCv2/v3 `creator_notes`)

fields.name: creatorNotesMultilingual
fields.meaning: localized creator notes, map<ISO 639-1, text> (CCv3 prefers this over single-language notes)

fields.name: publicNote
fields.meaning: public "from the creator" note shown on the card page (RC creators_note; DISTINCT from creatorNotes)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.meaning: unix seconds

fields.name: rating
fields.meaning: explicit content rating; keep out of free-text tags

fields.name: contentWarnings
fields.meaning: optional trigger/content warnings, card-portable

fields.name: label
fields.meaning: human label for an expression/outfit/pose variant (RoleCall sprite label)

fields.name: primary
fields.meaning: the primary asset of its role (e.g. the "main" portrait among many)

fields.name: ref
fields.meaning: reference into the entity's asset store, or a data URI

shapes.name: Sprite
shapes.doc: Agnai builder-authored composite avatar: named part selections + palette. Open keys so new part slots do not require a schema change; the rendered images are assets, this is the authored RECIPE.

fields.name: assets
fields.meaning: extra images / expression + outfit + pose packs (Risu .charx, RoleCall sprites)

fields.name: sprite
fields.meaning: Agnai composite-avatar recipe (visualType "sprite")

fields.name: visualKind
fields.meaning: which visual mode the creator chose: "avatar" | "sprite" (open; Agnai visualType)

fields.name: faceLabel
fields.meaning: Preferred expression-pack label for this body (or variant override). Display binds the portrait stage to that pack face when present; not a second asset store.

shapes.name: Swatch
shapes.doc: A named color swatch in a card's palette (RoleCall casting-card colors[]).

shapes.name: Background
shapes.doc: A creator-curated background, optionally a video with playback controls (RoleCall default_background).

shapes.name: Presentation
shapes.doc: The casting-card presentation layer: a creator's visual identity for the character (RoleCall signature palette, curated background, field order, definition spoilers). Optional; formats without a presentation concept simply omit it.

fields.name: signatureColor
fields.meaning: the character's signature color when it is a single solid (RC details.signature_color, Risu theme color). A signature that is a blend rides in gradientColors instead - one concept, two storage shapes. Account-level accent color is deliberately not modeled here: it belongs to the user's account, not the card.

fields.name: gradientColors
fields.meaning: the character's signature when it is a blend of 2-3 colors (RC details.gradient_colors)

fields.name: fieldOrder
fields.meaning: creator-chosen display order of definition fields (bento layout)

fields.name: spoilers
fields.type: { mode?: string; order?: string[]; fields?: Record<string, boolean> }
fields.meaning: spoiler / reveal-order config over the public definition fields. `fields` is the authored per-field boolean map (RC publicDefinitionDisplay.spoilers) - previously collapsed to mode/order and LOST.

fields.name: mediaLinks
fields.meaning: creator-supplied external reference links on the casting card (RC details.media_links)

shapes.name: CharacterSettings
shapes.doc: Creator-authored behavior dials (SillyTavern's "Advanced Definitions"): inline settings a creator tunes on the character itself. Distinct from `behaviorRefs`, which LINKS to regex/script entities; these are values, not references. An editable section in the forge.

fields.name: talkativeness
fields.meaning: group-chat turn-frequency weight, 0..1 (SillyTavern `extensions.talkativeness`)

fields.name: risu
fields.type: { /** side-screen mode: "none" | "emotion" | "imggen" (open) */ viewScreen?: string; largePortrait?: boolean; inlayViewScreen?: boolean; utilityBot?: boolean; lorePlus?: boolean; }
fields.meaning: Risu authored display/behavior toggles (single-platform but creator-set, so first-class per the schema-is-editor doctrine). Grouped so the origin is obvious and other formats never emit them.

fields.name: responseSchema
fields.meaning: Agnai structured-output config (`json` ResponseSchema): authored response-shaping the creator built in Agnai's schema editor. Carried verbatim-editable; likely migrates to the Preset entity later.

shapes.name: TriggerScript
shapes.doc: A trigger state-machine script (Risu triggerscript): condition/effect rows, verbatim-editable.

fields.name: event
fields.meaning: the triggering event (Risu `type`: "output", "input", "start", ...)

shapes.name: CharacterBehavior
shapes.doc: AUTHORED BEHAVIOR content - the card's scripts, first-class and editable (schema-is-editor), with a hard security line: the converter/editor NEVER executes any of this. No eval, no require, no DOM injection. Execution happens ONLY inside the capability sandbox (design/SANDBOX-SPEC.md: isolated WASM/VM engines + narrow host bridge + structural deny-by-absence permission manifest), a later milestone. Behavior never blind-copies cross-format: it re-emits only on its own format's wire.

fields.name: virtualScript
fields.meaning: JS virtual-script payload, verbatim-editable text (Risu virtualscript)

fields.name: backgroundHTML
fields.meaning: custom background markup/styles, verbatim-editable text (Risu backgroundHTML/backgroundCSS)

fields.name: defaultVariables
fields.meaning: script-engine seed values (Risu defaultVariables), verbatim-editable

fields.name: prebuiltAsset
fields.type: { command?: string; exclude?: string[]; style?: string }
fields.meaning: prebuilt-asset generation config (Risu prebuiltAssetCommand/Exclude/Style)

fields.name: moduleToggles
fields.meaning: module toggle config string (Risu customModuleToggle)

fields.name: privileged
fields.meaning: the card REQUESTED the privileged low-level script API (Risu lowLevelAccess). A warning marker for the UI and a sandbox gating input - never an execution trigger.

fields.name: presentation
fields.meaning: creator's visual identity for the card, when the source format carries one

fields.name: settings
fields.meaning: authored inline behavior dials (talkativeness, ...)

fields.name: bias
fields.meaning: Character-level phrase/logit bias (Risu `bias` [phrase, weight] pairs). NOTE: a DIFFERENT axis than NovelAI's entry/category-level loreBiasGroups (rich groups, modeled on the lorebook side when its reconciled shape lands) - two homes because they are genuinely two concepts.

fields.name: worldName
fields.meaning: authored external worldbook link by NAME (SillyTavern `extensions.world`): the creator's intent to auto-load the worldbook called X. Distinct from knowledgeRefs, which links embedded books by canonical id.

fields.name: knowledgeRefs
fields.meaning: linked canonical lorebook id(s), ordered; embedded on export where a format requires it

fields.name: behavior
fields.meaning: authored script/behavior content carried ON the card (Risu); see CharacterBehavior's security line

fields.name: behaviorRefs
fields.meaning: linked canonical regex/script entity id(s) - for STANDALONE behavior files (ST/Lumiverse regex)

fields.name: variants
fields.meaning: alternate versions of this character (copied from RoleCall's variant mechanic): each OVERRIDES a subset of fields; the editor shows the base with the active one merged in. See ./variant.ts.

shapes.name: CharacterVariant
shapes.doc: A character variant - an alternate version that can override ANY field of the base (inspired by RoleCall's variant mechanic, generalized). `overrides` is a deep partial of the body; applyVariant (./variant.ts) deep-merges it onto the base, so a variant may change one field or the whole persona. A field is overridden when the key is PRESENT in `overrides` (set it to "" to clear); absent keys inherit from the base.

fields.name: mirrorBase
fields.meaning: RC's two modes. true/undefined (mirror, default): deep-overlay the overrides, unset fields inherit from the base. false (full override): each section the variant defines REPLACES the base's whole section (base fields in it drop), untouched sections still inherit, and the character keeps a name (base name falls through when the override omits it).

fields.name: overrides
fields.meaning: the fields this variant changes - any subset of the canonical body, deep-merged onto the base
